instr: Paper folding: a sheet is folded and a hole is punched through it; pick how the sheet looks when opened again.
clue: The pictures show a square sheet of paper being folded (the shaded part folds over along the dashed line, as the arrow shows). In the last picture a hole is punched through all layers. Which of the four sheets shows where the holes are when the paper is opened again? Click or tap a sheet, or press its number key 1 to 4. Press Start when ready.
options: Which sheet is right when opened?
